name: Xiao Liang
source:
Her laughter blazes as bright as sunlight. She acts like an unstoppable whirlwind, charging forward without hesitation. She constantly repeats a line no one fully understands — "Life is chess."
Yet no one truly walks beside her.
When she first meets Chen You and the rest, her warmth makes it feel as if they have been friends for a whole decade. Later, however, they come to realize: she seems to have no other friends at all.
Her laughter is loud and boisterous. But when it echoes across empty spaces, it can sound as though someone else is weeping.
What is she chasing? Or could the endless running itself be her true secret?
